issues.title: Test file not co-located with component
issues.description: The rule requires test files to be in the same directory as component files. The test file flow-icon-text.test.tsx was moved to a __tests__ subdirectory instead of being co-located with flow-icon-text.tsx in the same directory.
issues.rule_name: React Component Test Files Must Be Co-Located

issues.title: QueryClient instance mismatch between router context and provider
issues.description: The Storybook decorator creates a QueryClient instance mismatch. The `createTestRouter` function instantiates a new QueryClient (`new QueryClient()`) and passes it to the router context on line 32. However, the decorator wraps the component with `QueryClientProvider` using the module-level `queryClient` instance on line 43. This creates two separate QueryClient instances - one for the router context and one for the provider. Queries executed within the router tree will use a different cache than queries executed through the provider, causing cache inconsistency and potential state synchronization issues. The router and provider should share the same QueryClient instance.

issues.title: Missing Suspense fallback causes blank UI during loading
issues.description: The FlowIconText component wraps FlowIconTextImplementation in a Suspense boundary but doesn't provide a fallback prop. When the component suspends while fetching flow data via useSuspenseQuery, React has no fallback content to display, resulting in a blank space in the UI until the query resolves. This creates a poor user experience with no loading indicator. The original implementation should have included a fallback prop like `<Skeleton className="h-4 w-full" />` to show a loading state during data fetching.

issues.title: Unused import violates Rule #12 noUnusedImports configuration
issues.description: The flow-icon-text.tsx file imports Skeleton from '@/components/ui/skeleton' on line 6 but never uses it in the component code. This directly violates Rule #12 'Unused Imports Must Be Automatically Removed' from AGENTS.md, which requires that unused imports be eliminated via automated linting. The biome.json configuration explicitly sets noUnusedImports as an error, meaning this should have been caught by pre-commit hooks. The unused import increases bundle size unnecessarily and indicates the linting process was bypassed or failed.

issues.title: Unused import: Skeleton
issues.description: `Skeleton` is imported but never used in this file, which violates the rule requiring unused imports to be removed.
issues.rule_name: Unused Imports Must Be Automatically Removed

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #20030 - Add FlowIconText component for UI v2 migration

structured_output.summary:
This PR adds `FlowIconText`, a small component that fetches a flow by ID with `buildFLowDetailsQuery` and renders a Workflow icon and the flow name as a link to `/flows/flow/$id`. It's essentially `FlowLink` without the "Flow" label. It also adds a Storybook story and an index export.

The component logic is correct, but the PR doesn't match its own description. The `Suspense` boundary has no fallback even though `Skeleton` is imported. That import is now unused, and the repo's Biome config sets `noUnusedImports` to error, so lint will fail. The described `flow-icon-text.test.tsx` isn't in the diff at all. The story also builds its own router instead of using the shared `reactQueryDecorator`/`routerDecorator` that the repo's Storybook guidelines require.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The unused `Skeleton` import fails Biome lint (`noUnusedImports: error`), and the empty Suspense fallback drops the loading state the description promises. The unit tests the description lists are also missing.

architecture.overview:
UI v2 link components (`FlowLink`, `DeploymentLink`, `WorkQueueLink`) all follow the same pattern. An outer component wraps an inner implementation in `<Suspense fallback={<Skeleton/>}>`. The inner implementation calls `useSuspenseQuery` with a query factory from `@/api/*` and renders a TanStack Router `Link` with an icon.

`FlowIconText` copies this pattern under `components/flows/flow-icon-text/`. It drops the "Flow" text prefix and the `text-xs` wrapper div and renders the `Link` directly. It reuses the existing `buildFLowDetailsQuery` (GET `/flows/:id`), and in Storybook the global MSW handler in `tests/utils/handlers.ts` answers that request.
steps: Start with `flow-link.tsx`, the existing pattern this component copies: Suspense with a Skeleton fallback, then a suspense query, then a Link.
Read `flow-icon-text.tsx`: the outer `FlowIconText` wraps `FlowIconTextImplementation` in a Suspense boundary that has no fallback.
It renders `<Link to="/flows/flow/$id">` containing a Workflow icon and `flow.name`.
`index.ts` re-exports the component; the story renders it inside a hand-built memory router, and the global MSW handlers answer the API call.

findings.title: Unused `Skeleton` import fails Biome lint; Suspense has no loading fallback
findings.fixPrompt: In `ui-v2/src/components/flows/flow-icon-text/flow-icon-text.tsx`, lines 14-16, the `<Suspense>` boundary has no fallback, so the `Skeleton` import (line 6) is unused. Biome's `noUnusedImports` rule is set to error in `ui-v2/biome.json`, so lint fails. Add `fallback={<Skeleton className="h-4 w-full" />}` to the Suspense, matching `ui-v2/src/components/flows/flow-link.tsx` lines 14-16. Then run `npm run lint` in ui-v2 to confirm it passes.

findings.title: Unit tests listed in the PR description are not in the diff
findings.fixPrompt: Add `ui-v2/src/components/flows/flow-icon-text/flow-icon-text.test.tsx`; the PR description promises it but it's missing. Model it on `ui-v2/src/components/deployments/deployment-link.test.tsx`: use MSW (`buildApiUrl` from `@tests/utils/handlers`) to mock GET `/flows/:id` with `createFakeFlow()`, render `FlowIconText` inside a QueryClientProvider and a TanStack memory router, and assert that the flow name appears and the link href is `/flows/flow/<id>`.

findings.title: Story builds its own router instead of using the shared Storybook decorators
findings.body:
The story builds its own root route, router, and QueryClient inside the decorator, and ignores `_Story`:

::diff{file="ui-v2/src/components/flows/flow-icon-text/flow-icon-text.stories.tsx" lines="20-49"}

This causes a few problems:
- `src/storybook/AGENTS.md` says to use `reactQueryDecorator` and `routerDecorator` from `@/storybook/utils` for components that use queries or `Link`.
- The decorator creates a new router on every render.
- The router's `context.queryClient` is a separate `new QueryClient()`, not the `queryClient` passed to the provider.
- Because `<Story />` is never rendered, story-level args and parameters only take effect through the `context.args.flowId` workaround.

findings.fixPrompt: In `ui-v2/src/components/flows/flow-icon-text/flow-icon-text.stories.tsx`, replace the hand-built `createTestRouter` decorator (lines 12-49) with `decorators: [reactQueryDecorator, routerDecorator]` imported from `@/storybook/utils`, as `ui-v2/src/storybook/AGENTS.md` requires. Remove the unused imports. Optionally add an MSW handler for GET `/flows/:id` that returns `createFakeFlow()` so the story shows realistic data.

findings.title: Follows the existing link-component pattern
findings.body: Besides the missing fallback, the component matches `FlowLink` and `DeploymentLink`. It reuses the shared `buildFLowDetailsQuery` factory, so the cache is shared with other flow views. It uses the same `/flows/flow/$id` typed route and the same `Workflow` icon. It doesn't add a new data-fetching path.
